reg [1:0] state;
	parameter [1:0]
		LEFT = 2'b00,
		RIGHT = 2'b01,
		STOP = 2'b10;

	always @(posedge clk or posedge areset) begin
		if (areset) begin
			state <= LEFT;
		end
		else begin
			case (state)
				LEFT: begin
					if (bump_left) begin
						state <= RIGHT;
					end
					else begin
						state <= LEFT;
					end
				end
				RIGHT: begin
					if (bump_right) begin
						state <= LEFT;
					end
					else begin
						state <= RIGHT;
					end
				end
				default: begin
					state <= LEFT;
				end
			endcase
		end
	end

	assign walk_left = (state == LEFT);
	assign walk_right = (state == RIGHT);

endmodule

reg [1:0] state;
	parameter [1:0]
		WALK_LEFT = 2'b00,
		WALK_RIGHT = 2'b01,
		AAAH = 2'b10;

	always @(posedge clk or posedge areset) begin
		if (areset) begin
			state <= WALK_LEFT;
		end
		else begin
			case (state)
				WALK_LEFT: begin
					if (ground) begin
						if (bump_left) begin
							state <= WALK_RIGHT;
						end
						else begin
							state <= WALK_LEFT;
						end
					end
					else begin
						state <= AAAH;
					end
				end
				WALK_RIGHT: begin
					if (ground) begin
						if (bump_right) begin
							state <= WALK_LEFT;
						end
						else begin
							state <= WALK_RIGHT;
						end
					end
					else begin
						state <= AAAH;
					end
				end
				AAAH: begin
					if (ground) begin
						state <= WALK_LEFT;
					end
					else begin
						state <= AAAH;
					end
				end
			endcase
		end
	end

	assign walk_left = (state == WALK_LEFT);
	assign walk_right = (state == WALK_RIGHT);
	assign aaah = (state == AAAH);

endmodule
